question: Article 19 of the Indian Constitution provides for how many types of freedoms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**6. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__** 

__
 
• ** Article 19**__

 __
 
• All citizens shall have the right-
 

 
 
• to freedom of speech and expression.
 
• to assemble peaceably and without arms;
 
• to form associations or unions;
 
• to move freely throughout the territory of India.
 
• to reside and settle in any part of the territory of India.
 
• to practice any profession, or to carry on any occupation, trade or business.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
 

 Article 13
 All laws in force in the territory of India immediately before the commencement of this Constitution, in so far as they are inconsistent with the provisions of this Part, shall, to the extent of such inconsistency, be void
 
 
 

 Article 44
 “The State shall endeavor to secure the citizen a Uniform Civil Code throughout the territory of India”.
 
 

 Article 60
 prescribes the Oath or affirmation by the President.
